messages:
Anika: starting bring-up for marlin-7b (mistral-style) on our llama-serving stack. getting weird mid-token splits in samples, more pronounced on long context.
Matt: example? short paste will help triage.
Anika: repro prompt 'Policy in 2035 will' -> sample 'Policy in 20/35 will' (slash is where model emits a subtoken boundary).
Sasha: that often points to tokenizer id remapping or a rotary angle misalignment. any custom merges during conversion?
Anika: yes, we merged a handful of rare ids to reduce vocab size (remap-edit.json). conversion command below.
Anika:```bash
convert-checkpoint \
  --src mistral --dst llama \
  --vocab-remap remap-edit.json \
  --rotary-gen auto \
  --preserve-eos=false
```
Jamie: note we defaulted --preserve-eos=false historically; some models rely on a fixed eos index. that could shift offsets.
Sasha: also check whether the model export used headwise freq scaling. if freq scale != 1 the generated rotary table needs headwise handling.
Anika: dumped tokens for the prompt: original token ids: [17, 4021, 9, 88, 52467] remapped ids: [17, 4021, 9, 88, 2106]
Matt: 52467 -> 2106 looks like a rare->common collapse. that would make the BPE segmentation differ from training-time behavior.
Sasha: confirm normalization form. marlin training used NFD historically; our tokenizer pipeline uses NFKC by default. mixing those can change boundaries.
Anika: switched to NFD normalizer and re-ran conversion without that single remap entry. output fixed for that prompt locally.
convert-bot: queued job convert-smoke-marlin-8965 (ETA 7m) :package:
rotary-bot: running rotary-index-scan #8965 :gear:
ml-ci: added repro test samples/repro_marlin_token_boundary.py to repo.
Jamie: even if remap was root cause, we should also verify rotary index alignment: dump first 12 kv-cache angles and compare against model's rotary.npy. phase drift shows up later in generation under long context.
Anika: attached kv dump (first 12 k/v positions): k_angles_hex: [0x3f2a..., 0x3f29..., ...] rotor_table_head0[0..11] differed by one index on head groups. swapping to model-supplied rotary.npy helped for longer prompts.
Matt: plan: 1) revert the problematic remap entry in remap-edit.json, 2) enforce NFD normalization when converting marlin, 3) prefer model-provided rotary table or run with --rotary-headwise=true if export used headwise scaling, 4) add conversion lint for rare->common collisions.
Sasha: also add a unit test that creates a short prompt and asserts no mid-token slashes in 50 samples. keep it fast.
Anika: doing the patch now and will run CI. PR when ready.
convert-bot: convert-smoke-marlin-8965 started (run id 4421).
ml-ci: rotary-index-scan #8965 finished: 2 mismatches (index_offset=1), baseline grid: headwise=true offset=0 passed.
Anika: pushed PR with remap revert + NFD default + docs update: https://git.redwood/marlin-conversions/pull/56 (includes before/after samples).
Jamie: when PR merges, update onboarding checklist: add a 'vocab-mapping sanity' step + rotary verification step under eng-ml/onboarding/marlin.
Matt: I'll open a small conversion-linter task to detect remap collisions where a high-id (>50000) maps to a low-id (<5000). prevents accidental merges.
Sasha: if anyone sees similar artifacts on other model brings, ping this thread. could be a pattern with manual merges + headwise exports.
Anika: thx all 44d will follow up with CI link once green.
ml-ci: convert-smoke-marlin-8965 run 4421: 4 tests passed, 1 failed (offset=1 case). failure under investigation.
